description: Search the full catalog of all 169 Yandex KIT API operations by keyword. Matches operationId, URL path, tag and Russian summary/description (the API docs are in Russian, so Russian keywords like "категории" work too). Any operation found here can be executed with kit_request; use get_operation_schema to inspect its parameters and body shape first.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 10)

query.description: Search keywords (whitespace-separated, case-insensitive; every token must match)

tag.description: Optional tag filter, e.g. "Товары" or "Вебхуки" (case-insensitive substring)

name: search_operations
title: Search KIT API operations
